name: Graveyard counts: its controller's, defending player's, the chosen player's, and a fired ability's 'your'
notes: Death's Approach of P1 on the opponent's Craw Wurm reads the Wurm's controller's one creature card (5/3). Animus of Night's Reach attacking the third player reads that player's three (3/4). Sewer Nemesis has a 'chosen player' list of all players; the third is picked (4 cards). The opponent's fired Chupacabra Echo targets P1's Knight (2/2 +2 lands): 'your' is the opponent's, one permanent card (3/3). Uurg, taken with Confiscate by the opponent, counts the opponent's land cards: none (0/5). Memory: project_graveyard_counts_by_owner_and_kind_2026-11-22.

steps.add: The Long Reach of Night // Animus of Night's Reach

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Knight of the Reliquary
scryfallData.oracle_text:
This creature gets +1/+1 for each land card in your graveyard.
{T}, Sacrifice a Forest or Plains: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth Tirel

scryfallData.name: Uurg, Spawn of Turg
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Uurg's power is equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)
{B}{G}, Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.

scryfallData.name: Death's Approach
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets -X/-X, where X is the number of creature cards in its controller's graveyard.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"It's cold in the grave, and the dead crave your warmth. Who are you to deny them?"
—Strava, Dimir mage

scryfallData.name: The Long Reach of Night // Animus of Night's Reach

card_faces.name: The Long Reach of Night
card_faces.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I, II — Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice unless they discard a card.
III — Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.

card_faces.name: Animus of Night's Reach
card_faces.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in defending player's graveyard.
card_faces.flavor_text: The dark myojin's gifts were instrumental in ending the Kami War.

scryfallData.name: Sewer Nemesis
scryfallData.oracle_text:
As this creature enters, choose a player.
Sewer Nemesis's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in the chosen player's graveyard.
Whenever the chosen player casts a spell, that player mills a card.
scryfallData.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

scryfallData.name: Chupacabra Echo
scryfallData.oracle_text: Fathomless descent — When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
scryfallData.flavor_text: It needs no food, yet still it hungers.

scryfallData.name: Confiscate
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant permanent
You control enchanted permanent.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "But I brought enough for the whole class!"
